contracts.commit_point: The 'with lock:' critical sections in ParquetCollector.add_nodes and add_relationships where self.nodes / self.relationships are concatenated or assigned.
contracts.declared_mechanism: A per-instance threading.Lock lazily created in ParquetCollector.model_post_init and acquired in add_nodes and add_relationships before any mutation.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Concurrent bundle-preparation tasks appending to the shared ParquetCollector's nodes/relationships dictionaries outside the collector lock (unsynchronized pa.concat_tables / dictionary assignment racing between threads).
pending_binding_information: Whether concurrent bundle preparation actually invokes the collector concurrently (task parallelism configuration not supplied).
Whether lock-free reads of the collector must also be serialized for the forbidden condition to hold is not specified in source.
contracts.protected_operation: ParquetCollector.add_nodes and ParquetCollector.add_relationships appends performed against the module-global collector during batch merge (collector.add_nodes / collector.add_relationships in merge_nodes_batch / merge_relationships_batch).
contracts.protected_resource: The module-global ParquetCollector instance (_parquet_collector, set via set_parquet_collector) and its nodes/relationships pa.Table dictionaries.
contracts.protection_obligation: Concurrent bundle-preparation tasks must not mutate the module-global ParquetCollector's node/relationship tables except inside its registered threading.Lock; the commit point is the 'with lock:' critical section inside add_nodes/add_relationships in genai_graph/kg/ingest/merge.py.
scope_limits: The lock covers only add_nodes/add_relationships mutations; count accessors get_node_count/get_relationship_count read the tables without the lock.
Guard is a process-internal threading.Lock; no multiprocess or cross-worker guarantee is declared.
Supplied views bind collector writes to the ingestion batch-merge path only; no agent tool in the supplied views writes to the collector.

contracts.commit_point: self.conn.execute(query, parameters) inside 'with _NATIVE_CALL_LOCK' in LadybugBackend.execute; super().execute_get_as_df(...) inside the same lock in execute_get_as_df; and the self.execute INSTALL/LOAD EXTENSION statements inside 'with _EXTENSION_LOCK' in _ensure_extension.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Two process-wide threading.RLock instances declared at module scope in genai_graph/kg/backend.py (_EXTENSION_LOCK, _NATIVE_CALL_LOCK) plus the _CALL_RE regex discriminator; execute()/execute_get_as_df() acquire _NATIVE_CALL_LOCK around conn.execute and whole-read materialization, and _ensure_extension() acquires _EXTENSION_LOCK around the INSTALL/LOAD pair with a double-checked per-connection _loaded_extensions cache.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Concurrent execution of INSTALL/LOAD EXTENSION statements, or of native CALL statements, against one shared Ladybug Database from multiple connections/threads corrupts the native heap (observed as SIGSEGV / 'malloc(): unsorted double linked list corrupted' / 'free(): invalid size' during parallel hybrid searches).
pending_binding_information: Whether raw-connection execute sites in genai_graph/kg/ingest/merge.py (conn.conn extraction followed by kuzu_conn.execute) are required to be serialized under the same locks is not established by the supplied guard wiring.
Whether _CALL_RE regex matching is the complete discriminator for native CALL statements (multi-statement or embedded forms) is not established.
Reviewer rationale claims the locked backend is used by the CLI; no CLI source view is supplied to confirm that entry point binding.
contracts.protected_operation: LadybugBackend.execute() and LadybugBackend.execute_get_as_df() execution of Cypher statements containing native CALL, and LadybugBackend._ensure_extension() issuance of INSTALL / LOAD EXTENSION statements (via ensure_vector_extension / ensure_fts_extension).
contracts.protected_resource: The process-shared ladybug.Database and its native connections backing the knowledge graph.
contracts.protection_obligation: All INSTALL/LOAD EXTENSION statements and native CALL statements (FTS/HNSW vector index queries, SHOW_INDEXES, table_info, show_tables, introspection) executed against a shared Ladybug/Kuzu Database must execute one-at-a-time process-wide: extension statements under _EXTENSION_LOCK and native CALL statements (including result materialization) under _NATIVE_CALL_LOCK, before the underlying conn.execute / result-walk commit.
scope_limits: The locks bind only statements routed through LadybugBackend.execute / execute_get_as_df / _ensure_extension; code that extracts the raw connection and executes directly (e.g., merge_nodes_batch via conn.conn) is outside the declared lock scope per the supplied wiring.
Ordinary MATCH/RETURN Cypher reads remain fully concurrent by design (backend.py 27-35); only CALL and extension statements are serialized.
Serialization is within one Python process only; no cross-process serialization is declared.
CALL detection is the _CALL_RE regex over the query string; the Neo4jBackend alternative is an unimplemented placeholder.

contracts.commit_point: _KEEPALIVE_BACKENDS.append(backend) at shared-connection creation in _connect, and the conn.close() call inside LadybugBackend.close() as the ordered teardown commit.
contracts.declared_mechanism: _KEEPALIVE_BACKENDS, a process-lifetime list retaining every backend created by _connect (append at shared-connection creation), plus LadybugBackend.close(), which explicitly invokes Connection.close() (closing cached results and prepared statements, then unregistering from the Database) before dropping references.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A Ladybug Connection object being garbage-collected while other threads still query the shared Database, corrupting the native heap (observed as SIGSEGV / 'free(): invalid size').
pending_binding_information: The implementation of genai_tk.utils.ladybug.get_shared_database and its shutdown-time ordered close path is not supplied; the shared-Database lifecycle beyond attach is unverified.
Whether keepalive retention is required for non-tool backend lifecycles is not established.
contracts.protected_operation: Creation and retention of per-thread Document Graph backends in _connect (attach to the process-shared Database via get_shared_database) and the ordered teardown performed by LadybugBackend.close().
contracts.protected_resource: The process-shared ladybug.Database and the per-thread LadybugBackend/Connection objects created by document_graph_tools._connect.
contracts.protection_obligation: Native Ladybug Connection objects attached to the process-shared Database for Document Graph access must never be garbage-collected while other threads still query the shared Database: every shared-DB backend created for tool access is retained for the process lifetime via _KEEPALIVE_BACKENDS, and teardown occurs only through the ordered Connection.close() path in LadybugBackend.close().
scope_limits: Keepalive registration is shown only for backends created via document_graph_tools._connect; other creation paths (create_backend_from_config, LadybugBackend.connect) are not shown registering keepalive.
close() suppresses exceptions and silently skips teardown when the Connection object lacks a close method.
The referenced interpreter-shutdown close hook (genai_tk.utils.ladybug.shared) is not among the supplied views.

contracts.commit_point: kuzu_conn.execute(merge_query) executing the LOAD FROM ... MERGE statement with the filtered ON MATCH SET clause in merge_nodes_batch.
contracts.declared_mechanism: _get_columns_for_set_clause filters the arrow-table column names before query construction: the key field is excluded entirely, and (with the default exclude_on_match = {'_created_at'}) every column ending in '_embedding' plus _created_at is removed from the ON MATCH SET column list.
contracts.forbidden_condition: An ON MATCH SET clause that includes a property covered by a vector (HNSW) index — Ladybug/Kuzu forbid in-place updates of vector-index-covered properties ('Cannot set property vec in table embeddings ...'); additionally, updating _created_at on match would overwrite the creation timestamp.
pending_binding_information: Whether vector indexes exist at merge time depends on flow ordering of the drop/create index tasks; the ordering across all orchestration flows is not fixed by the supplied views.
Whether the _created_at exclusion carries the same enforcement weight as the vector-index prohibition or is only a semantic convention is not established beyond source comments.
contracts.protected_operation: merge_nodes_batch execution of the batch statement 'LOAD FROM arrow_table MERGE (n:NodeType {pk: pk}) ON CREATE SET ... ON MATCH SET ...' for each node type.
contracts.protected_resource: Node table properties covered by HNSW vector indexes (e.g., *_embedding columns) and the _created_at sentinel column on Ladybug node tables.
contracts.protection_obligation: When batch-merging nodes into Ladybug/Kuzu, the ON MATCH SET clause must exclude vector-index-covered *_embedding columns (and the _created_at timestamp); the column filter computed by _get_columns_for_set_clause must take effect before the LOAD FROM arrow_table MERGE execution in merge_nodes_batch.
scope_limits: The filter applies only to the ON MATCH column list; ON CREATE SET still includes embedding columns.
Exclusion is name-based (suffix '_embedding'); a vector-index-covered property not named with that suffix would not be excluded.
The guard is static query construction; index drop/recreate is handled separately by drop_vector_indexes_task / create_vector_indexes_task.
Supplied views bind this operation to the ingestion batch-merge path; no agent tool in the supplied views reaches merge_nodes_batch.
